edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria)
scope: Additional readings keyed by Masoretic reference, separate from the Parallel Reader’s aligned rows. Entries with staging links document the earlier staging capture. New editorial readings were prepared in the GitHub archive.

6:4.hebrew: וְשִׁבְעָה כֹהֲנִים יִשְׂאוּ שִׁבְעָה שׁוֹפְרוֹת הַיּוֹבְלִים לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּסֹבּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהַכֹּהֲנִים יִתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת׃
6:4.english: Seven priests shall carry seven ram’s-horn trumpets before the ark. On the seventh day you shall circle the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

8:13.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ הָעָם אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֲשֶׁר מִצְּפוֹן לָעִיר וְאֶת־עֲקֵבוֹ מִיָּם לָעִיר וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵמֶק׃
8:13.english: The people took up their positions, the whole camp north of the city and its rear guard west of the city. That night Joshua went into the middle of the valley.

8:26.hebrew: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ לֹא־הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָטָה בַּכִּידוֹן עַד אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱרִים אֵת כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעָי׃
8:26.english: Joshua did not draw back the hand with which he held out the javelin until he had put all the inhabitants of Ai under the ban.
8:26.editorial_note: The verb heḥerim denotes putting under the ban, here by destroying the inhabitants, as the preceding verses describe.

10:15.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃
10:15.english: Joshua returned to the camp at Gilgal, and all Israel returned with him.
10:15.editorial_note: The Masoretic Text repeats this sentence at 10:43.

10:43.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַגִּלְגָּלָה׃
10:43.english: Joshua returned to the camp at Gilgal, and all Israel returned with him.

13:33.hebrew: וּלְשֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי לֹא־נָתַן מֹשֶׁה נַחֲלָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נַחֲלָתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לָהֶם׃
13:33.english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. YHWH, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as He told them.

20:4.hebrew: וְנָס אֶל־אַחַת מֵהֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְעָמַד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וְדִבֶּר בְּאָזְנֵי זִקְנֵי־הָעִיר הַהִיא אֶת־דְּבָרָיו וְאָסְפוּ אֹתוֹ הָעִירָה אֲלֵיהֶם וְנָתְנוּ־לוֹ מָקוֹם וְיָשַׁב עִמָּם׃
20:4.english: He shall flee to one of these cities, stand at the entrance to the city gate, and state his case to its elders. They shall take him into the city, give him a place, and let him live among them.

20:5.hebrew: וְכִי יִרְדֹּף גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אַחֲרָיו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּרוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּיָדוֹ כִּי בִבְלִי־דַעַת הִכָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵא הוּא לוֹ מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃
20:5.english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, they shall not hand the killer over to him, for he struck his neighbor unknowingly and had not hated him before.

20:6.hebrew: וְיָשַׁב בָּעִיר הַהִיא עַד־עָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אָז יָשׁוּב הָרוֹצֵחַ וּבָא אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נָס מִשָּׁם׃
20:6.english: He shall stay in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment and until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the killer may return to his city and his home, to the city from which he fled.
